title: Managed pi-web functional surface
description: Exercise one marked pi-chrome workspace through an inert chat turn, read-only connector probes, files, history, terminal coexistence, Chrome/Preview health, and inspector ownership.

requires.cloudRun: Creates one billable marked pi-chrome service
requires.piProvider: Use an already configured QA provider; missing model access is blocked
requires.readOnlyMcp: An existing read-only connector may be present; no server is created or mutated
requires.turnBudget: At most two live turns, each bounded to 120 seconds; no CRM writes or Goal execution

steps.expected: The marked session access response is ready and the embedded Agent UI reports readiness without a second browser or runner process.
The upstream native Goal control is visible when the pinned runtime exposes it; absence is a failure, and no Mapache legacy Goal bridge is used.
A one-question native Goal fixture remains paused until an explicit user action; no background Goal execution is accepted.
Preview remains available beside the embedded agent and reports its safe readiness state.
One completed assistant response is visible with the requested MIGRATION_QA_OK text or a recorded provider failure; a provider failure is a case failure, not a pass.
The completed conversation appears once after switching between Agent and Terminal views; no transcript is duplicated or rewritten.
The preconfigured read-only connector is called once with no write-capable operation; any missing connector is blocked rather than replaced with a mock pass.
